title: The Exact Money Formula Rich People Actually Use
description:
Wealthy people don't have a secret stock tip — they follow one simple formula that most people have never heard of. It's called the 15-65-20 rule, and it's the real reason some people build wealth quietly while others earn great money and stay broke.

In this video, we break down exactly how the 15-65-20 rule works: the 15% that goes to your future self and compounds into real wealth, the 65% cap on living expenses that protects you from lifestyle inflation, and the 20% guilt-free spending that keeps the whole system sustainable for the long run. You'll also see the real math behind starting early vs. starting late, why employer retirement matches are free money, and how to actually apply this rule even if you're starting from zero.

This isn't financial advice — it's a breakdown of the simple system that consistently shows up in people who build real, lasting wealth instead of just earning a good paycheck. If you've ever felt like you make decent money but somehow never get ahead, this formula is for you.
